title: Law to extend and update transgender jail task force rules
summary: This bill would amend a 2019 law that created a task force reviewing Department of Correction policies on the treatment and housing of transgender, gender nonconforming, non-binary and intersex people in custody. It would extend the task force's minimum duration to one year after its fifth annual report, require the task force to elect its own chair within 90 days, replace a Council appointee with a Speaker appointee, and require greater participation by the Department of Correction and Correctional Health Services. It also updates and clarifies other provisions of the original law.
